_doc: One row per deliverable (Excel_NAME = the GFIX-side job name, e.g. RJDSWM40). Built by gfixRecv.plan from today's WBS rows (+ mapping.xlsx rows dated today, for GFIX_TIME / FileCount; FileCount -1 = not known); the three day-flows checkpoint into track / logs / evidence.

dashboard._doc: ebi status / ebi menu: the columns shown between the key and the verdict columns, in this order (else every non-key non-verdict column, as many as fit in 80 columns)
dashboard._dateColumn_doc: the row's day: when no row carries today's date, NEXT says run plan first (10/16: the earlier days' rows made it say track)
